grading: Unmodified v6 end_to_end per case, all conversation turns must pass. Independent full-template/known-slot and manual safety reviews separately flag defects; never silently change frozen scores. Fallback/provider errors cannot pass as live-model answers.
blindness: Implementation/evaluator frozen before question authorship. New synthetic questions are not added to application knowledge or tests. Agent-authored evaluation, not a separate human blind study.
providerAuthorization: Existing explicit authorization for fal.run course-only synthetic evaluation material applies; no learner data, credentials, or unrelated files sent.
pipelineBoundary: Actual unchanged route/service/retrieval/response modules. Synthetic auth/course/entitlement and in-memory sessions; loopback HTTP. Course-only transport projection documented. Not a production DB or deployed UI test.
providerFailurePolicy: Preserve diagnostics and stop if approved provider access fails. No fabricated responses or weakened acceptance criteria.
connectivityProbe: Explain the trade-off between a clean silhouette and surrounding visual clutter when teaching a learner to present an unbranded cork desk organiser. Answer in English.
